name: edit_transaction
description: Multi-file edits with rollback and preview. Different edits per file supported. Prefer over edit for multi-file or risky changes. Single-file: use edit_batch.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory.

txn_id.description: Transaction ID (required for edit, edit_multi, commit, rollback, info).

file.description: Single file path relative to workspace_dir (required for action=edit).

files.description: Multiple file paths relative to workspace_dir. Same edits applied to all (broadcast mode).

edits.description: Array of edits. Required for edit. For edit_multi: required with files (broadcast), or use file_edits for per-file edits.
Array of edits for this file

file_edits.description: Per-file edits for edit_multi. Each item: {file, edits}. When provided, overrides files+edits. Use when different files need different edits.
